critique.evidence: Strong dark editorial system, disciplined cyan/red/green semantics, crisp borders, and clear verified-versus-mismatch hierarchy. Tablet is the most balanced. Desktop feels top-heavy: the oversized headline and sparse right column create excessive dead space before the main artifact. Mobile preserves structure but the headline wraps awkwardly, the chart becomes nearly illegible, and dense microcopy strains readability. The global header is polished on desktop, but tablet/mobile navigation looks visibly clipped; mobile also loses the brand name and presents a cryptic SWIPE cue. Contrast proof for several header links is incomplete.
critique.fix: Rebalance the desktop hero into a tighter grid, reduce mobile headline size/line breaks, give the mobile chart more height and larger labels, increase microcopy size/contrast, and redesign narrow-header navigation with a clear current-section indicator and deliberate overflow treatment.
